name: Дневной отсек: серебристый рассеянный свет
about: Светлый интерьер станции: рассеянный серебристый свет сверху, тёплая кожа против серого металла, стол завален бумагами, кружками и приборами — всё выписано.
style_notes_en: painterly digital concept art with photographic weight, rendered as a film keyframe rather than a photograph or a classical painting; practical light sources visible or implied inside the frame; full value range down to true black; visible brush economy on metal and fabric while the focal object holds crisp detail; worn lived-in objects — mugs, taped paper, handwritten notes, scuffed panels — rendered with the same care as the machinery; desaturated palette split warm against cool; wide cinematic framing with foreground objects cropped by the frame edge; a bright habitat interior under soft silvery diffuse toplight, warm skin tones against grey brushed metal, a working table strewn with papers, mugs, pens and instruments all fully rendered, high detail across the whole frame, palette of aluminium grey, bone white and warm flesh
